s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, ulcerative, purpuric skin lesion with rapid growth and extension
salient_findings: Enlarging purpuric patch on the left lateral superior forehead and left anterior scalp
Multifocal peripheral reddish-purple patches, papules, and macules
key_facts: Lesion first developed in March 2014
Rapid growth and extension occurred in June 2014
Lesion is 30 × 25-cm in size
Centrally eroded purpuric plaque with multifocal peripheral lesions
Involvement of left anterior scalp, left parietal scalp, left forehead, and left lateral cheek
Extension to right frontal and right parietal scalp
No evidence of lymphadenopathy
Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
Strong immunopositivity for ADRB1, ADRB2, and ADRB3 receptors

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth and ulceration of a purpuric skin lesion, with histopathological features of irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and cells staining positively with CD31

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Purpuric skin lesions with multifocal involvement, including the scalp and face, and histopathological features of slitlike spaces and CD31-positive cells

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, ulcerative skin lesions with rapid growth and extension, and involvement of multiple areas of the body

shortlist.label: Leukemia cutis
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of the skin with a rapidly growing, ulcerative lesion, and histopathological features of dermal infiltration by atypical cells

shortlist.label: Mycosis fungoides
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive skin lesions with multifocal involvement, including the scalp and face, and histopathological features of atypical lymphocytes

raw.rationale: The presence of irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes in the dermis, cells staining positively with CD31, and strong immunopositivity for ADRB1, ADRB2, and ADRB3 receptors support the diagnosis of Angiosarcoma, a malignant vascular tumor.

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: While Kaposi's sarcoma can present with purpuric lesions, the described histopathological features and immunopositivity profile do not specifically align with Kaposi's sarcoma.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not support a diagnosis of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, which typically involves atypical lymphocytes and different immunophenotyping.

rejected.label: Leukemia cutis
rejected.why: Leukemia cutis involves infiltration of the skin by leukemic cells, which is not consistent with the vascular tumor characteristics described in the case.

rejected.label: Mycosis fungoides
rejected.why: Mycosis fungoides is a type of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma and does not match the vascular tumor features and immunohistochemical profile presented in the case.
